Hymn 323: Rise Up, O Men of God
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: William H. Walter
Lyricist/Text Author: William P. Merrill
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 323 titled "Rise Up, O Men of God" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William H. Walter and the lyrics were written by William P. Merrill.
